definition_zh: 回答；答复；答案；解答；应门；接听；回应；负责；相符
definition_en: something said or written in reply to a question, or a solution to a problem; also to reply, to pick up a call, or to be responsible for something
core_image: 被问住之后，把一个对得上的东西抛回去
scene: 图书馆的咨询台前，女孩把一张写满问题的纸条推了过去。The librarian answered every question in a calm, steady voice.
sceneCN: 这里 answer 是「回答、答复」（第 1 个义项：对问题作出的口头或书面回复）；句意为图书管理员用平静稳定的声音回答了每一个问题。画面里有咨询台、写满问题的纸条和低头记录的馆员。

pos.zh: 名词：回答；答复；答案；解答
动词：回答；答复；应门；接听；负责；相符

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -able 构成，义为「可答复的；应负责的」
由否定前缀 un- 加过去分词构成，义为「未回答的；无人应答的」
由本词与 phone 复合，义为「电话答录机」，英式用法
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「回答者；应答者」

senses.title: A reply to a question
senses.definition: something said or written in reply to a question, letter, or request
senses.definitionCN: 对问题、来信或请求作出的口头或书面回复
senses.example: Her answer to the interviewer was short but clear.
senses.exampleCN: 她对面试官的回答简短而清楚。
senses.why: Old English andswaru literally meant a statement sworn back against a question, so the reply is something returned to the one who asked.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 andswaru 字面是「对着问题回过去的一句陈述」，所以回答是抛回给提问者的东西。

senses.title: A solution to a problem
senses.definition: the correct or needed solution to a problem, puzzle, or exercise
senses.definitionCN: 问题、谜题或练习的正确或所需的解答
senses.example: Nobody in the class could find the answer to the last equation.
senses.exampleCN: 班上没人能解出最后那道方程的答案。
senses.why: A problem is a question put to the world, and the working solution is the reply that closes it.
senses.whyCN: 难题是抛给世界的一个问句，真正行得通的解法就是把它合上的那个回应。

senses.title: To open the door or pick up the phone
senses.definition: to open the door or pick up the telephone when someone knocks or calls
senses.definitionCN: 有人敲门或来电时去开门或去接电话
senses.example: Could you answer the door while I finish this call?
senses.exampleCN: 我把这个电话打完，你能去开一下门吗？
senses.why: A knock or a ring is a request without words, and going to it is the reply made with the body.
senses.whyCN: 敲门声或铃声是没有字的请求，走过去开门就是用身体做出的回答。

senses.title: To respond to a call or appeal
senses.definition: to respond to a call, signal, or appeal, often by taking action
senses.definitionCN: 对呼唤、信号或呼吁作出反应，通常以行动回应
senses.example: The volunteers answered the appeal for blood donors within hours.
senses.exampleCN: 志愿者们在几小时内就响应了献血呼吁。
senses.why: Here the reply is an action rather than a sentence: the call goes out and someone comes.
senses.whyCN: 这里的回答是行动而不是语句：呼声发出，有人就来了。

senses.title: To be responsible for
senses.definition: in answer for, to take responsibility for someone or something and accept the blame or duty
senses.definitionCN: 用于 answer for，表示为某人或某事负责，并承担过失或义务
senses.example: The driver had to answer for the damage to the parked car.
senses.exampleCN: 那名司机必须为撞坏停放车辆负责。
senses.why: The image turns legal: the accused must reply to the charge, and that reply carries the weight of the consequences.
senses.whyCN: 意象转向法律：被指控者必须对指控作出答复，而这个答复要承担后果的重量。

senses.title: To match a description
senses.definition: in answer to, to match a description, name, or need
senses.definitionCN: 用于 answer to，表示与描述、名称或需要相符
senses.example: The cottage answers to the description in the old letter.
senses.exampleCN: 那间小屋与旧信里的描述相符。
senses.why: A description is a question about what something should be like, and the thing that fits it gives the matching reply.
senses.whyCN: 描述是关于「某物应当是什么样」的提问，与之相符的事物就给出了对得上的回答。

intro.en: Answer is a native Old English word, not a Latin borrowing; its oldest shape pictures a statement sworn back at someone.
intro.cn: answer 是古英语本族词，并非拉丁语借词；它最早的样子是「对着某人回过去的一句陈述」。

items.en: The noun andswaru was built from the prefix and- 'against, in return' and swaru 'a swearing, statement', which belongs with swerian 'to swear'. The deeper root of swerian is generally reconstructed as a verb of speaking.
items.cn: 名词 andswaru 由前缀 and-「对着、回报」与 swaru「誓言、陈述」构成，后者与动词 swerian「发誓」同族。swerian 的更早词根一般被重构为表示「说话」的动词。

items.en: The verb andswarian 'to speak in reply' grew up beside the noun, so the pair always meant a return of words.
items.cn: 动词 andswarian「作答、回应」与名词一同发展，因此这一对词始终表示「把话还回去」。

items.en: The form settles as answere, and by the fourteenth century the sense of a solution to a problem is already present.
items.cn: 词形在中期英语固定为 answere；到十四世纪，已经出现「问题的解答」这一义项。

items.en: The reply extends from words to actions: one can answer a knock, a ring, or an appeal.
items.cn: 「回答」从言语扩展到行动：人可以应门、接电话，也可以响应一项呼吁。

items.en: The formal phrases answer for and answer to take shape, one for responsibility and one for matching.
items.cn: 正式短语 answer for 与 answer to 逐渐定型，一个表示负责，一个表示相符。

items.en: The core remains 'a return to a question'. Latin respondere and responsum mean the same thing but belong to another family and are not the source of this word.
items.cn: 核心始终是「对提问的回还」。拉丁语 respondere 与 responsum 意思相同，却属于另一个词族，并不是这个词的来源。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the words built on answer itself; the near-meaning group gathers replies and solutions that differ in tone and reach.
note.cn: 形近组收由 answer 本身构成的一族词；近义组收各种回复与解答，语气和适用范围各有不同。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning responsible to someone or able to be answered.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「应负责的；可答复的」。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning not replied to or not picked up.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「未回答的；无人接听的」。

entries.definition: A noun for a machine that records telephone messages, British usage.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「电话答录机」，为英式用法。

entries.definition: A spoken or written response, often to a letter or a remark.
entries.definitionCN: 口头或书面的回应，多指对来信或话语的答复，比 answer 更强调「回话」这一动作。

entries.definition: To react to something, especially in a deliberate way.
entries.definitionCN: 对某事作出反应，尤指有意识地回应，语气比 answer 正式。

entries.definition: The answer to a problem, often one that works in practice.
entries.definitionCN: 问题的解答，常指实际可行的解决办法，偏重「解」而不是「答」。

entries.definition: A quick, sharp reply, usually made in an argument.
entries.definitionCN: 迅速而锋利的回嘴，多出现在争辩中，带有情绪。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old English prefix, the swear-statement stem, and the frames answer actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的古英语前缀、表示「陈述」的词干，以及这个词实际出现的句式。

normal.en: and- means 'back against', so an answer is words sent back at the asker.
normal.cn: and- 表示「回对着」，所以 answer 就是朝提问者送回去的话。

normal.en: The stem swaru is the same family as swear, which is why the reply was once a sworn statement.
normal.cn: 词干 swaru 与 swear 同族，这正是回答曾经是「一句誓言」的原因。

normal.en: The everyday frame is answer a question or answer the phone.
normal.cn: 日常句式是 answer a question 或 answer the phone。

normal.en: Answer for is responsibility; answer to is matching or obeying.
normal.cn: answer for 是负责，answer to 是相符或服从。

normal.en: Unanswered adds un- and keeps the -ed participle, giving 'not replied to'.
normal.cn: unanswered 加 un- 并保留 -ed 分词，表示「未被回答的」。

abstract.en: Picture a question thrown like a ball: the answer is the throw that comes straight back to the hand.
abstract.cn: 想象一个问题像球一样被扔出去：answer 就是笔直回到手里的那一投。

abstract.en: Picture a locked gate and a key that fits exactly: the solution is an answer that matches the shape of the problem.
abstract.cn: 想象一把锁和一把恰好吻合的钥匙：解答就是与问题形状对得上的那个回答。

abstract.en: Picture a phone ringing in an empty room: an answer is not just words but a hand reaching out.
abstract.cn: 想象空房间里电话响起：answer 不只是话语，还是一只伸出去的手。

examples.en: She answered the letter the same evening, before her resolve could fade.
examples.cn: 她当晚就回了信，趁决心还没有消退。

examples.en: There is no simple answer to the housing shortage.
examples.cn: 住房短缺问题没有简单的答案。

examples.en: He knocked twice, but nobody answered the door.
examples.cn: 他敲了两次门，却没有人来应门。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安啥」——有人喊「安啥」，他回头给了一句答复：回答

root: 古英语 andswaru「回答」由前缀 and-（对着、回报）与 swaru（誓言、陈述，与 swerian「发誓」同族）构成；动词 andswarian 与名词同时发展。词义由「把话还回去」扩展到「问题的解答」「应门」「负责」「相符」。

sensesIntro.en: Six senses fan out from one gesture: words returned to a question, then a solution, then a physical response, then a responsibility, and finally a match between a thing and its description.
sensesIntro.cn: 六个义项从同一个动作展开：把话还给提问者，然后是问题的解答，再是用身体作出的回应，接着是承担责任，最后是一物与其描述之间的吻合。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a question goes out, and something that fits it comes back.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个问句发出去，一个对得上的东西回到手里。

branches.en: THE REPLY LINE: what is said back to the person who asked.
branches.cn: 回应线：说回给提问者的那句话。

branches.en: THE SOLUTION LINE: the reply that closes a problem instead of a conversation.
branches.cn: 解答线：合上问题而不是合上对话的那个回复。

branches.en: THE BODY LINE: the reply made by opening a door, lifting a phone, or showing up.
branches.cn: 身体线：用开门、拿电话或到场做出的回答。

branches.en: THE DUTY LINE: the reply that carries blame and must be accounted for.
branches.cn: 责任线：带着过失、必须作出交代的那个答复。

branches.en: THE FIT LINE: the reply a thing gives when it matches its description.
branches.cn: 吻合线：一物与描述相符时给出的那个回答。

intro.en: Answer is built from an Old English prefix and a statement stem; English suffixes and the negative prefix then extend the family.
intro.cn: answer 由古英语前缀与表示「陈述」的词干构成；英语后缀与否定前缀再把这一词族向外扩展。

latinIntro.en: No Latin word is ancestral to answer. The Latin respondere and responsum are listed here only as semantic parallels, and the Latin entry list is therefore left empty.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁语词是 answer 的祖先。拉丁语 respondere 与 responsum 只是意思上的平行词，因此拉丁同源列表留空。

items.example: It turns a statement into a reply.
items.exampleCN: 它把一句陈述变成一句回应。

items.example: It is the stem behind the reply.
items.exampleCN: 它是「回答」背后的词干。

items.example: It belongs to the same family as swaru.
items.exampleCN: 它与 swaru 属于同一词族。

items.meaning: the shared stem of the family
items.example: It appears in answerable and answering.
items.exampleCN: 它出现在 answerable 与 answering 中。

items.example: It forms answerer.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 answerer。

items.meaning: able to be, or worthy of
items.example: It forms answerable.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 answerable。

items.meaning: forming the past tense and participle
items.meaningCN: 构成过去式与过去分词
items.example: It forms answered and unanswered.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 answered 与 unanswered。

items.example: It forms answering.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 answering。

items.example: It forms unanswered.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 unanswered。

definition_zh: 预料；预期；提前行动；抢先；预先考虑并满足；预先支用
definition_en: to expect that something will happen and often act before it does, or to deal with a matter in advance
core_image: 在事情落下来之前，先把手伸到它要落的位置
scene: 机场到达厅里，接机的人举着牌子，早早就站到了出口边上。We anticipate a busy holiday season and booked extra staff months ago.
sceneCN: 这里 anticipate 是「预料、预期」（第 1 个义项：预期某事将会发生）；句意为公司预料到假日旺季会很忙，几个月前就多订了人手。画面里有到达厅、举牌接机的人与行李车。

pos.zh: 及物动词：预料；预期；提前准备；抢先；预先支用

collocations.zh: 预先想到并满足某人的需要
预先想到别人要问的问题

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ion 构成，义为「预期；期望；预先行动」
由本词加 -ory 构成，义为「预先的；预期的」
由本词加 -ive 构成，义为「有预知倾向的；期待中的」
由否定前缀 un- 加过去分词构成，义为「未预料到的」

senses.title: To expect something will happen
senses.definition: to expect that something will happen, often based on signs or experience
senses.definitionCN: 预期某事将会发生，常以迹象或经验为依据
senses.example: Economists anticipate a slow recovery next year.
senses.exampleCN: 经济学家预期明年会缓慢复苏。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant 'to take beforehand', and expecting is already taking the future into your hands.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词本义是「事先拿到」，而「预期」本就是先把未来拿到手里。

senses.title: To act before someone else
senses.definition: to act before another person or group does, so as to gain an advantage
senses.definitionCN: 在他人或其他团体之前行动，以取得优势
senses.example: The company anticipated its rivals by launching the app first.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司抢先推出应用，占了对手的先机。
senses.why: If the future can be taken in advance, then acting first is simply taking it before anyone else reaches it.
senses.whyCN: 既然未来可以事先拿到，那么抢先行动不过是赶在别人伸手之前把它拿走。

senses.title: To see and meet a need in advance
senses.definition: to notice a need before it is expressed and satisfy it in advance
senses.definitionCN: 在某项需要被说出口之前就察觉并提前满足它
senses.example: A good host anticipates the guests' needs before they ask.
senses.exampleCN: 好的主人会在客人开口之前就想到并满足他们的需要。
senses.why: A need is a future request; meeting it early means answering the request before it is spoken.
senses.whyCN: 需要是尚未说出口的请求；提前满足它，就是在这句话说出之前先行回答。

senses.title: To use money or income in advance
senses.definition: to spend or use money, income, or profit before the time it is due
senses.definitionCN: 在款项到期之前就花掉或动用金钱、收入或利润
senses.example: He anticipated part of his salary to pay the rent.
senses.exampleCN: 他预支了一部分薪水来付房租。
senses.why: This is the Latin image at its most literal: drawing tomorrow's money into today's hand.
senses.whyCN: 这是拉丁意象最字面的用法：把明天的钱拉到今天的掌心里。

senses.title: To cause something to happen early
senses.definition: to make something happen earlier than it otherwise would
senses.definitionCN: 使某事比原本会发生的时刻更早发生
senses.example: The report anticipated the debate by a full week.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告把辩论足足提前了一周。
senses.why: Taking the future in advance can also drag it forward: the event arrives sooner because it was pulled.
senses.whyCN: 把未来事先拿到，也可以把它往前拖：事件之所以更早到来，是因为它被拉了过来。

intro.en: Anticipate is a straight Latin borrowing whose two halves still show: ante 'before' plus capere 'to take'.
intro.cn: anticipate 是直接从拉丁语借来的词，两半依然看得见：ante「在前」加 capere「拿取」。

items.en: The preposition and prefix ante meant 'before, in front of', and it also carried the idea of preference or priority.
items.cn: 介词兼前缀 ante 意为「在……之前、在……前面」，也带有「优先」的意味。

items.en: The verb capere meant 'to take, seize, grasp', and it is the source of a large family including capture and concept.
items.cn: 动词 capere 意为「拿、抓、握住」，是 capture、concept 等一大族词的来源。

items.en: Ante plus capere formed anticipare 'to take before, take up in advance, forestall', with the participle anticipatus.
items.cn: ante 与 capere 构成 anticipare「事先拿取、提前占用、先发制人」，其过去分词为 anticipatus。

items.en: English borrowed the word directly from Latin in the sixteenth century; the earliest English sense was 'to take or use beforehand'.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪直接从拉丁语借入这个词；最早的英语义项是「事先拿取或动用」。

items.en: The sense of expecting now dominates, while the older 'act first' sense survives mainly in business, sport, and military writing.
items.cn: 今天「预期」占主导，较早的「抢先行动」义主要保留在商业、体育与军事文字中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the derived family; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of looking ahead, differing in how certain the future is and how early one acts.
note.cn: 形近组收本词的派生一族；近义组收各种「往前看」的动词，未来有多确定、行动有多早各有不同。

entries.definition: The noun for the feeling or act of expecting something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「预期、期待」，指期待某事的心情或行为。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning done or felt in advance of something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「预先的、提前的」，指在某事之前就做出或感受到。

entries.definition: The past participle used as an adjective: expected or awaited.
entries.definitionCN: 过去分词作形容词，义为「被预期的、期盼中的」。

entries.definition: To think that something will probably happen, without necessarily acting on it.
entries.definitionCN: 认为某事很可能发生，但不一定据此行动，是最中性的「预期」。

entries.definition: To say in advance what will happen, especially from evidence or calculation.
entries.definitionCN: 依据证据或推算事先说出将会发生什么，偏重「断言未来」。

entries.definition: To see or know something before it happens, often through judgment.
entries.definitionCN: 在事情发生之前看出或知道，多凭判断力，带有「有先见」的意味。

entries.definition: To act before others so as to prevent their action.
entries.definitionCN: 抢先行动以阻止他人行动，比 anticipate 更强调「先占住」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two real Latin halves, the participle, and the frames the verb actually takes.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的两个拉丁语成分、分词形式，以及这个动词实际搭配的句式。

normal.en: ante plus capere: taking before the thing has even arrived.
normal.cn: ante 加 capere：在东西还没到就先拿住。

normal.en: The shared cap- root also gives capture and captive, all about taking hold.
normal.cn: 共同的 cap- 词根还生出 capture 与 captive，都与「抓住」有关。

normal.en: The everyday frame is anticipate problems or anticipate that something will happen.
normal.cn: 日常句式是 anticipate problems 或 anticipate that 加从句。

normal.en: Anticipation is the noun of the waiting feeling before an event.
normal.cn: anticipation 是名词，指事件到来之前那种等待的心情。

normal.en: Anticipated in a headline means the event people have been waiting for.
normal.cn: 标题里的 anticipated 指众人一直在等的那件事。

abstract.en: Picture a hand already open under a window before the dropped key reaches it.
abstract.cn: 想象钥匙还没落下，一只手已经在窗下摊开等着。

abstract.en: Picture a chess player moving a piece to the square the opponent will need two moves later.
abstract.cn: 想象棋手把棋子挪到对手两步之后才要用的那格。

abstract.en: Picture a host pouring tea before the guest has said the word thirsty.
abstract.cn: 想象客人还没说出「渴」字，主人已经把茶倒上。

examples.en: Nobody anticipated how quickly the small protest would grow.
examples.cn: 没有人预料到那场小规模抗议扩散得如此之快。

examples.en: She anticipated his question and had the figures ready.
examples.cn: 她预先想到了他的问题，把数字都备好了。

examples.en: The nurses anticipated the storm and moved the patients to the upper floor.
examples.cn: 护士们预见到暴风雨，提前把病人转移到了楼上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安提西陪他」——提前安顿好、陪着他等，就是预料在先

root: 拉丁语 ante（在前）+ capere（拿取）→ anticipare（事先拿取、抢先）；过去分词 anticipatus 进入英语。词义由「提前拿用」扩展为「预料」「抢先」「预先满足需要」，core image 始终是「手先伸到事情要落的位置」。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses move from knowing the future to acting on it: expect it, arrive before rivals, meet a need early, draw money forward, and even pull the event closer.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个义项从「知道未来」走到「对未来动手」：预期它、赶在对手之前、提前满足需要、把钱提前取出，甚至把事件本身拉近。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching out to where something has not yet fallen.
core.cn: 核心意象：手先伸到某物尚未落下的那个位置。

branches.en: THE EXPECTATION LINE: the future is known before it arrives.
branches.cn: 预期线：未来在到来之前就已被看见。

branches.en: THE RACE LINE: the same early reach becomes an advantage over rivals.
branches.cn: 抢先线：同样的提前伸手，变成对对手的优势。

branches.en: THE CARE LINE: the early reach is directed at another person's unspoken need.
branches.cn: 体贴线：提前伸出的手朝向他人尚未说出的需要。

branches.en: THE MONEY LINE: taking tomorrow's resources into today.
branches.cn: 钱款线：把明天的资源拉到今天。

branches.en: THE PULL LINE: the future event itself is dragged nearer.
branches.cn: 前拉线：未来事件本身被拖得更近。

intro.en: Anticipate keeps Latin ante and the cap- root, then adds English verb and noun suffixes.
intro.cn: anticipate 保留拉丁语的 ante 与 cap- 词根，再加上英语的动词与名词后缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin family is transparent: ante, capere and the derived anticipare and anticipatio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语这一族很清楚：ante、capere，以及由它们构成的 anticipare 与 anticipatio。

definition_zh: 焦虑；忧虑；担心；令人焦虑的事；渴望；焦虑状态
definition_en: a feeling of worry and nervousness about something uncertain, or a strong wish to do something
core_image: 胸口被一只看不见的手慢慢收紧，却还找不到要发生的事
scene: 考试前夜，学生一遍遍翻着笔记本，手心全是汗。Her anxiety before the exam kept her awake until dawn.
sceneCN: 这里 anxiety 是「焦虑、忧虑」（第 1 个义项：对不确定之事的担心与不安）；句意为考试前的焦虑让她一直清醒到天亮。画面里有台灯、摊开的笔记本和发汗的手。

pos.zh: 名词：焦虑；忧虑；担心；焦虑的事；渴望

derivatives.zh: 由同一拉丁词干加 -ious 构成，义为「焦虑的；渴望的」
由 anxious 加 -ly 构成，义为「焦虑地；急切地」
由 anxious 加 -ness 构成，义为「焦虑的状态」
由 anxi- 与希腊语词根构成，义为「抗焦虑的；抗焦虑药」

senses.title: A feeling of worry and unease
senses.definition: a feeling of worry and nervousness about something uncertain that may happen
senses.definitionCN: 对可能发生却又不确定之事感到担心和紧张的情绪
senses.example: The uncertainty about the job left her full of anxiety.
senses.exampleCN: 工作前景的不确定让她满心焦虑。
senses.why: Latin angere meant to squeeze the throat, and the feeling is still a tightening that has no clear object yet.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 angere 意为「勒紧喉咙」，这种感受至今仍是一种还没有明确对象的收紧。

senses.title: Something that causes worry
senses.definition: a situation, matter, or person that causes worry and unease
senses.definitionCN: 引起担心与不安的处境、事情或人
senses.example: Money was a constant anxiety for the young couple.
senses.exampleCN: 钱的问题一直是这对年轻夫妇的焦虑来源。
senses.why: The feeling can also name its own cause, so the thing that tightens the chest is called an anxiety too.
senses.whyCN: 这种情绪也可以用来称呼它的起因，于是那个让胸口收紧的东西也被叫作焦虑。

senses.title: An eager wish
senses.definition: a strong or eager wish to do something or to have something happen
senses.definitionCN: 强烈而急切地想要做某事或让某事发生的愿望
senses.example: He waited with anxiety for the letter to arrive.
senses.exampleCN: 他急切地等着那封信到来。
senses.why: The same tightening comes from wanting as from fearing: the body cannot tell a hoped-for event from a dreaded one.
senses.whyCN: 「想要」与「害怕」引起的是同一种收紧：身体分不清盼来的事和怕来的事。

senses.title: A clinical anxiety condition
senses.definition: a medical condition marked by persistent, excessive worry that interferes with daily life
senses.definitionCN: 以持续、过度的担忧干扰日常生活为特征的医学状态
senses.example: The clinic treats anxiety as well as depression.
senses.exampleCN: 这家诊所既治疗焦虑症，也治疗抑郁症。
senses.why: When the tightening never loosens and starts to block ordinary life, the everyday feeling is given a clinical name.
senses.whyCN: 当这种收紧一直不松开，并开始妨碍日常生活，日常情绪就被赋予了一个临床名称。

intro.en: Anxiety comes from Latin, and its oldest image is physical: a throat being squeezed shut.
intro.cn: anxiety 来自拉丁语，它最古老的意象是身体性的：喉咙被掐紧。

items.en: The verb angere meant 'to choke, squeeze, strangle', and also 'to trouble, torment'. It is the same root behind English anger and anguish.
items.cn: 动词 angere 意为「使窒息、挤压、勒住」，也有「使苦恼、折磨」的意思。英语的 anger 与 anguish 同出这个词根。

items.en: Its adjective anxius meant 'troubled, uneasy, anxious', literally 'tightened', keeping the image of a constricted throat.
items.cn: 由它构成的形容词 anxius 意为「不安的、忧虑的」，字面是「被勒紧的」，保留了喉咙收紧的意象。

items.en: The abstract noun anxietas named the state itself: distress, uneasiness, anxiety.
items.cn: 抽象名词 anxietas 直接命名这种状态：痛苦、不安、焦虑。

items.en: English borrowed anxiety from Latin in the sixteenth century, at first mainly in learned and religious writing.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪从拉丁语借入 anxiety，最初多用于学术与宗教文字。

items.en: The word splits into two registers today: ordinary worry about uncertain events, and a diagnosed anxiety disorder in medicine.
items.cn: 今天这个词分成两个层面：日常对不确定事件的担忧，以及医学上被诊断的焦虑症。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the anxious family; the near-meaning group gathers words for unease that differ in cause, strength, and whether a doctor would use them.
note.cn: 形近组收 anxious 这一族词；近义组收表示不安的词，起因、强度以及医生是否会使用各有不同。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning worried, or eagerly wanting something.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「焦虑的；渴望的」，是本词对应的形容词。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in a worried or eager manner.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「焦虑地；急切地」。

entries.definition: A German borrowing meaning a deep, often existential dread; it belongs to the same choking root.
entries.definitionCN: 来自德语的借词，义为「深层的、常带存在意味的恐惧」，同出「勒紧」这一词根。

entries.definition: A state of thinking about problems and possible troubles.
entries.definitionCN: 反复想着问题与可能的麻烦的状态，比 anxiety 更口语、更贴近具体事由。

entries.definition: A feeling of interest mixed with worry about someone or something.
entries.definitionCN: 夹杂着关心的担忧，语气比 anxiety 温和，也常指「大家关注的事」。

entries.definition: A mild feeling that something is not right, often without a clear cause.
entries.definitionCN: 轻微的「不对劲」感，常无明确原因，强度低于 anxiety。

entries.definition: Fear or worry that something bad will happen, usually with a known object.
entries.definitionCN: 对将要发生坏事的担忧，通常有明确对象，比 anxiety 更接近「预感不妙」。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real choking root, its Latin noun, and the frames anxiety actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的「勒紧」词根、它的拉丁名词，以及这个词实际出现的句式。

normal.en: angere means to squeeze the throat, so anxiety is a tightened chest that cannot name its cause.
normal.cn: angere 意为勒紧喉咙，所以 anxiety 是一种说不出原因的胸口收紧。

normal.en: Anger, anguish and angst all sit beside anxiety on the same root.
normal.cn: anger、anguish 与 angst 都与 anxiety 同坐在这一个词根上。

normal.en: The everyday frame is anxiety about something or anxiety over a decision.
normal.cn: 日常句式是 anxiety about 某事物，或 anxiety over 某个决定。

normal.en: Anxiety disorder is the clinical use, where the worry does not switch off.
normal.cn: anxiety disorder 是临床用法，指担忧关不掉的状态。

normal.en: The plural anxieties often names several concrete worries at once.
normal.cn: 复数 anxieties 常一次指好几件具体的忧心事。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closing slowly around a throat before any danger has appeared.
abstract.cn: 想象危险还没出现，一只手已经慢慢收拢在喉咙上。

abstract.en: Picture a smoke alarm that keeps ringing in a room with no fire.
abstract.cn: 想象没有火的房间里，烟雾报警器一直响个不停。

abstract.en: Picture a person carrying an unopened envelope all day, afraid to look inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人整天揣着没拆的信，既想看又不敢看。

examples.en: His anxiety about the interview showed in the way he kept straightening his tie.
examples.cn: 他对面试的焦虑，从他不停整理领带的动作里看得出来。

examples.en: The new policy has become a major source of anxiety for small businesses.
examples.cn: 新政策已成为小企业的一大焦虑来源。

examples.en: She felt a strange anxiety to see him again after so many years.
examples.cn: 隔了这么多年，她竟有种想再见到他的急切。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安哉提」——心里喊「安哉」，却还是提着一口气：焦虑

root: 拉丁语 angere（勒紧喉咙、使窒息）→ anxius（被勒紧的、不安的）→ anxietas（焦虑状态）。同根词包括 anger、anguish、angst。词义从身体的「收紧」转为心理的「担忧」，再分出医学上的焦虑状态。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses follow the same tightness outward: the unnamed feeling, the thing that causes it, the eager version of it, and the clinical state where it never loosens.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项沿着同一股「收紧」向外走：说不清对象的情绪、引发它的东西、它急切的那一面，以及一直不松开的临床状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a throat tightened by a hand that has not yet found a reason.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手掐紧喉咙，却还没找到理由。

branches.en: THE FEELING LINE: unease with no clear object.
branches.cn: 感受线：还没有明确对象的不安。

branches.en: THE CAUSE LINE: the thing outside that keeps the hand closed.
branches.cn: 起因线：外面那个让手一直收着的东西。

branches.en: THE EAGER LINE: the same tightening produced by wanting instead of fearing.
branches.cn: 急切线：同样的收紧，由「想要」而不是「害怕」造成。

branches.en: THE DIAGNOSIS LINE: the tightening stays on and becomes a medical condition.
branches.cn: 诊断线：收紧不再松开，成为一种医学状态。

branches.en: THE OUTSIDE LINE: the inner feeling and the outer cause are named with the same word.
branches.cn: 内外线：内心的感受与外面的起因，用同一个词来称呼。

intro.en: Anxiety keeps a Latin root of squeezing plus the abstract suffix -iety, and its adjective branch adds -ous, -ly and -ness.
intro.cn: anxiety 保留表示「挤压」的拉丁词根，加上抽象后缀 -iety；它的形容词分支再加 -ous、-ly 与 -ness。

latinIntro.en: The Latin chain is angere, anxius, anxietas, and a later combining form anxio- used in medical words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁链条是 angere、anxius、anxietas，以及医学词里后来出现的组合形式 anxio-。

items.exampleCN: 它构成 anxiolytic，即放松焦虑的药物。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 它是整个词族的根。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 它是 anxious 的直接基础。

definition_zh: 焦虑的；担心的；渴望的；令人不安的
definition_en: feeling worried and nervous about something uncertain, or strongly wanting to do or have something
core_image: 心被一只看不见的手捏着，眼睛不停往未来的方向瞟
scene: 车站广播说列车晚点，母亲一遍遍看表，又望向出口。The mother was anxious about her son's late train.
sceneCN: 这里 anxious 是「焦虑的、担心的」（第 1 个义项：对不确定之事感到担心）；句意为母亲为儿子那趟晚点的列车而担心。画面里有车站广播、反复看表的母亲与空荡的出口。

pos.zh: 形容词：焦虑的；担心的；渴望的；令人不安的

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「焦虑地；急切地」
由本词加 -ness 构成，义为「焦虑；急切」
由 over- 加本词构成，义为「过度焦虑的」
与本词同出拉丁语 anxius 的名词，义为「焦虑；忧虑」

senses.title: Worried about something uncertain
senses.definition: feeling worried and nervous because something is uncertain or may go wrong
senses.definitionCN: 因为事情不确定或可能出错而感到担心和紧张
senses.example: She grew anxious when the test results did not arrive.
senses.exampleCN: 检查结果迟迟不来，她越来越担心。
senses.why: The Latin adjective anxius is literally 'tightened', so the person is pictured with a chest held shut by fear.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁形容词 anxius 字面是「被勒紧的」，所以这个人被画成胸口被恐惧收住的样子。

senses.title: Eager to do something
senses.definition: strongly wanting to do something or to have something happen
senses.definitionCN: 强烈地想做某事或希望某事发生
senses.example: He was anxious to please his new colleagues.
senses.exampleCN: 他急切地想讨新同事喜欢。
senses.why: Wanting pulls the chest just as tightly as fearing, so the same adjective serves both directions of feeling.
senses.whyCN: 「想要」和「害怕」一样会把胸口收紧，所以同一个形容词可以服务两个方向的情绪。

senses.title: Causing worry
senses.definition: describing a period, moment, or situation that makes people feel worried
senses.definitionCN: 形容让人感到担心的时段、时刻或处境
senses.example: There was an anxious silence before the verdict was read.
senses.exampleCN: 宣读裁决之前有一段令人不安的沉默。
senses.why: By a common shift the feeling word comes to describe the thing that produces it, as if the silence itself were tight.
senses.whyCN: 情绪词常发生这样的转移，转而形容引起它的东西，仿佛那段沉默本身就是绷紧的。

intro.en: Anxious is the Latin adjective behind anxiety, imported with the same physical image of a squeezed throat.
intro.cn: anxious 是 anxiety 背后的那个拉丁形容词，带着同样「喉咙被勒紧」的身体意象进入英语。

items.en: The verb angere meant 'to choke, squeeze, strangle' and also 'to torment'; it is shared with anger and anguish.
items.cn: 动词 angere 意为「使窒息、挤压、勒住」，也有「折磨」的意思；它与 anger、anguish 共用这个词根。

items.en: The adjective anxius described a person as 'tightened, uneasy, troubled', not merely as sad or afraid.
items.cn: 形容词 anxius 把人描述为「被勒紧的、不安的、苦恼的」，不只是悲伤或害怕。

items.en: English took anxious from Latin; early uses were close to 'troubled' and 'full of concern'.
items.cn: 英语从拉丁语引入 anxious；早期用法接近「苦恼的」「满怀忧虑的」。

items.en: The sense 'eager to do something' develops in ordinary speech, especially in the frame anxious to please.
items.cn: 「急于做某事」的义项在日常口语中发展出来，尤其见于 anxious to please 这一句式。

items.en: Today anxious covers worry, eagerness, and even the anxious silence that makes others worry.
items.cn: 今天 anxious 覆盖担忧、急切，甚至包括让别人担忧的那种「令人不安的沉默」。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the same Latin family; the near-meaning group gathers worry adjectives that differ in strength and in whether desire is involved.
note.cn: 形近组收同一拉丁词族；近义组收表示担忧的形容词，强度以及是否含「渴望」各有不同。

entries.definition: The noun for the state of worry or eager desire.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「焦虑；渴望」，是本词对应的名词。

entries.definition: The adverb meaning in a worried or eager way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「焦虑地；急切地」。

entries.definition: The noun for the quality of being anxious.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「焦虑、急切的状态」。

entries.definition: Feeling troubled about a specific problem or possible trouble.
entries.definitionCN: 为具体问题或可能的麻烦而心烦，事由通常说得清，比 anxious 更口语。

entries.definition: Feeling tense and jumpy, especially before an event or performance.
entries.definitionCN: 紧张而容易受惊，尤指在事件或表演之前，偏重身体的紧绷感。

entries.definition: Feeling mildly uncomfortable because something seems wrong.
entries.definitionCN: 因觉得不对劲而略感不适，强度低于 anxious。

entries.definition: Strongly wanting to do or have something, without the worry that anxious carries.
entries.definitionCN: 强烈地想做或想要，但不带 anxious 那层担忧，语气更明亮。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the squeezing root, the anxious to do frame, and the three directions the adjective can point.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用「收紧」词根、anxious to do 句式，以及这个形容词能指向的三个方向。

normal.en: The root angere squeezes the throat, so anxious is a tightened chest.
normal.cn: 词根 angere 会勒紧喉咙，所以 anxious 就是收着的胸口。

normal.en: Anxious about points at a worry; anxious to points at a wish.
normal.cn: anxious about 指向担忧，anxious to 指向愿望。

normal.en: Anxiety is the noun of the same state, with the abstract suffix -iety.
normal.cn: anxiety 是同一状态的名词，带抽象后缀 -iety。

normal.en: An anxious silence is a silence that makes other people anxious.
normal.cn: an anxious silence 是让别人也变得不安的沉默。

normal.en: The family keeps the same stem across anxious, anxiety, anxiously and anxiousness.
normal.cn: anxious、anxiety、anxiously、anxiousness 共用同一个词干。

abstract.en: Picture a bird on a wire, wings half open, never quite settling.
abstract.cn: 想象电线上的一只鸟，翅膀半张，始终落不踏实。

abstract.en: Picture a hand gripping a railing before the stairs are even visible.
abstract.cn: 想象楼梯还没看见，手已经先抓住了扶手。

abstract.en: Picture an envelope held over a candle, not yet opened but already warm.
abstract.cn: 想象一封信举在烛火上，还没打开却已经发烫。

examples.en: The children were anxious about the first day at their new school.
examples.cn: 孩子们为转学第一天感到担心。

examples.en: She was anxious to finish the report before the office closed.
examples.cn: 她急着在办公室关门前把报告写完。

examples.en: An anxious hour passed before the doctor came out.
examples.cn: 令人不安的一小时过去了，医生才走出来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「昂克舍斯」——昂着头、克着心、舍不得放下：焦虑的

root: 拉丁语 angere（勒紧喉咙）→ anxius（被勒紧的、不安的）→ 英语 anxious。同根词有 anger、anguish、angst，名词形式为 anxiety。词义从身体的「收紧」扩展为心理的「担忧」与「渴望」。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses spread from one tightened chest: worry about what may happen, eagerness for what is wanted, and the atmosphere that makes others feel the same.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项从同一个收紧的胸口散开：对可能之事的担忧、对想要之物的急切，以及让别人也产生同感的氛围。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a chest held shut by an unseen hand while the eyes keep looking ahead.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手暗暗收着胸口，眼睛却一直往前方看。

branches.en: THE WORRY LINE: the tightened chest pointed at something uncertain.
branches.cn: 担忧线：收紧的胸口对着某件不确定的事。

branches.en: THE WISH LINE: the same tightness produced by wanting rather than dreading.
branches.cn: 愿望线：同样的收紧由「想要」而非「害怕」造成。

branches.en: THE ATMOSPHERE LINE: the feeling spreads into the room and makes others tense.
branches.cn: 氛围线：这种情绪扩散到房间里，让别人也绷起来。

branches.en: THE MIRROR LINE: the person feels the tightness, and the moment is described by the same word.
branches.cn: 镜像线：人感到收紧，而那个时刻也用同一个词来描述。

branches.en: THE OUTWARD LINE: eager reaching and uneasy air both pull other people forward.
branches.cn: 向外线：急切的伸取与不安的气氛，都会把旁人往前拉。

intro.en: Anxious adds the adjective suffix -ious to the Latin stem anx-, and the family then takes -ly, -ness and the prefix over-.
intro.cn: anxious 在拉丁词干 anx- 上加形容词后缀 -ious；这一族随后再接 -ly、-ness 与介词性前缀 over-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is anxius, built on angere; anxiety is its abstract noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁基础是建立在 angere 之上的 anxius；anxiety 是它的抽象名词。

definition_zh: 任何的；任一；一些；丝毫；无论哪个
definition_en: one or some of a group, no matter which; also used in questions and negatives for an amount or degree that is not fixed
core_image: 把一个整类摊开，随手点中一个，不问是哪一个
scene: 深夜的便利店门口，店员对着一脸犹豫的顾客摊开手。Take any seat you like; the whole row is free.
sceneCN: 这里 any 是「任何一个」（第 1 个义项：指同类中的任意一个，不指明是哪一个）；句意为「随便坐哪个座位都行，整排都是空的」。画面里有深夜的店门、空着的座位和店员摊开的手。

pos.zh: 限定词：任何的；任一；一些
代词：任何一个；任何一些
副词：丝毫；稍微（多用于否定句与疑问句）

forms.label: 限定词用法（无屈折变化）

derivatives.zh: 由 any 与 thing 复合，义为「任何事物」
由 any 与 one 复合，义为「任何人」
由 any 与 body 复合，义为「任何人」
由 any 与 where 复合，义为「在任何地方」

senses.title: One member, no matter which
senses.definition: used with a singular noun to point at one member of a group without saying which one
senses.definitionCN: 与单数名词连用，指某一类中的任意一个，并不指明是哪一个
senses.example: Take any seat you like; the whole row is free.
senses.exampleCN: 随便坐哪个座位都行，整排都是空的。
senses.why: The Old English ancestor is simply the word for 'one' plus an adjective suffix, so the word began as a way of naming a single member while refusing to choose which.
senses.whyCN: 古英语的来源就是表示「一」的词加一个形容词后缀，所以它一开始就是在指出单个成员，却拒绝挑明是哪一个。

senses.title: Some, in questions and negatives
senses.definition: used in questions and negative sentences for an amount or number that is not fixed or not known
senses.definitionCN: 用于疑问句和否定句，表示数量不固定或尚不清楚的一些
senses.example: Do you have any questions about the schedule?
senses.exampleCN: 你对这份日程还有什么问题吗？
senses.why: In a question the speaker cannot tell whether the amount exists at all, so the firm 'one' loosens into 'some, if there is any'.
senses.whyCN: 在疑问句里，说话人根本不知道这个量是否存在，于是坚定的「一」松动成「如果有的话，那么一些」。

senses.title: Even the smallest amount
senses.definition: used in negative statements to stress that not even a very small amount or degree is present
senses.definitionCN: 用于否定句，强调连极小的一点数量或程度都不存在
senses.example: She did not show any sign of doubt.
senses.exampleCN: 她没有露出丝毫怀疑的迹象。
senses.why: The notion of 'one' shrinks to a single unit of evidence; denying even that unit makes the denial absolute.
senses.whyCN: 「一」缩到最小的一份证据，连这一份都否认，否定就变得绝对。

senses.title: Whichever one, in a condition
senses.titleCN: 无论哪一个（用于条件从句）
senses.definition: used in clauses with if or whether to mean that it does not matter which member is involved
senses.definitionCN: 用于由 if 或 whether 引导的从句，表示无论涉及哪一个成员都无所谓
senses.example: If any of the boxes is damaged, send it back at once.
senses.exampleCN: 这些箱子中如果有任何一个损坏，请立刻退回。
senses.why: The conditional frame removes the need to identify the item: whichever one turns up will trigger the same result.
senses.whyCN: 条件句的框架免去了指认的必要：不管冒出来的是哪一个，都会触发同样的结果。

senses.title: Any person or thing at all
senses.definition: as a pronoun, one or some person or thing, chosen freely and left unnamed
senses.definitionCN: 作代词时，指某个人或某件物，自由选取而不点明
senses.example: I need a pen; any will do.
senses.exampleCN: 我需要一支笔，哪支都行。
senses.why: Standing alone as a pronoun, the word keeps the same open choice but no longer has a noun to lean on.
senses.whyCN: 单独作代词时，这个词保留着同样敞开的选择，只是再没有名词可以让它依靠。

intro.en: Any is a native Old English word, made by joining the numeral 'one' to a small adjective suffix; it is not a borrowed form.
intro.cn: any 是古英语本族词，由数词「一」接一个小的形容词后缀构成，并不是借来的形式。

items.en: The form ǣnig was built from ān 'one' and the adjective suffix -ig, so its earliest sense was 'one-like, a single one'.
items.cn: 形式 ǣnig 由 ān「一」与形容词后缀 -ig 构成，因此最早的义项是「像一那样的、单个的」。

items.en: Even in Old English the word already appears in questions and negations, where the sense moves from 'one' to 'some at all'.
items.cn: 早在古英语时期，这个词就已经出现在疑问与否定语境里，义项由「一」转向「到底有没有那么一些」。

items.en: The spelling settles as any, and the word spreads to plural nouns, where 'one' becomes 'some of a number'.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 any，用法扩展到复数名词，于是「一」变成「若干之中的一些」。

items.en: The adverbial use develops, letting the word mean 'in any degree', especially inside a negative clause.
items.cn: 副词用法发展起来，使这个词可以表示「在任何程度上」，尤其是在否定从句中。

items.en: The compounds anybody, anyone, anything and anywhere are fully fixed, and any works mainly as a determiner or pronoun.
items.cn: 复合词 anybody、anyone、anything、anywhere 完全定型，any 主要作限定词或代词使用。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the compounds built on any; the near-meaning group gathers quantifiers that also leave the choice open but differ in scope.
note.cn: 形近组收由 any 构成的复合词；近义组收同样把选择敞开的量词，区别在于范围与语气。

entries.definition: A pronoun meaning any person, used chiefly in questions and negatives.
entries.definitionCN: 代词，义为「任何人」，主要用于疑问句与否定句。

entries.definition: A pronoun meaning any thing, without limit of kind.
entries.definitionCN: 代词，义为「任何事物」，不限定种类。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in or to any place.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「在任何地方、到任何地方」。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in any way or in spite of that.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「以任何方式」或「无论如何」。

entries.definition: An unspecified amount or number, used mainly in affirmative sentences.
entries.definitionCN: 表示不确定的数量，主要用于肯定句，与疑问、否定中的 any 形成分工。

entries.definition: Every one of a group, taken one by one rather than freely chosen.
entries.definitionCN: 指一组中的每一个，逐个看待，而不是随意挑一个。

entries.definition: Any one of a known set, no matter which.
entries.definitionCN: 指已知范围内的任何一个，无论哪一个，选择范围比 any 更明确。

entries.definition: Anything at all of a kind, with the widest possible range.
entries.definitionCN: 指某一类中的任何事物，范围最宽，语气也最强。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Old English numeral and suffix, plus the compounds the word actually forms.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用真实的古英语数词与后缀，以及这个词实际构成的复合词。

normal.en: The core is ān, the numeral 'one', so any always starts from a single item.
normal.cn: 核心是数词 ān「一」，所以 any 始终从单个事物出发。

normal.en: Add -ig, an adjective suffix, and 'one' becomes 'one-like, any one'.
normal.cn: 加上形容词后缀 -ig，「一」就变成「像一那样的、任何一个」。

normal.en: In a question the single item turns into 'some at all': do you have any?
normal.cn: 在疑问句里，单个事物变成「到底有没有一些」：你有没有 any？

normal.en: The family is regular: any plus thing, one, body, where, how, way.
normal.cn: 这一族很规整：any 加 thing、one、body、where、how、way。

normal.en: Remember the pair: some lives in statements, any lives in questions and denials.
normal.cn: 记住这一对：some 住在陈述句里，any 住在疑问与否定里。

abstract.en: Picture a hand sweeping over a whole shelf and stopping nowhere in particular.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手扫过整排货架，却不在任何特定处停下。

abstract.en: The word is a door left open: every option is allowed, none is named.
abstract.cn: 这个词是一扇敞开的门：每个选项都被允许，却没有一个被点名。

abstract.en: Denial sharpens it: not any means not even one grain is left.
abstract.cn: 否定让它变锋利：not any 意味着连一粒都不剩。

examples.en: Any child in the village could name every star in that corner of the sky.
examples.cn: 村里任何一个孩子都能叫出那片天空中每颗星的名字。

examples.en: We searched the shore for any trace of the missing boat.
examples.cn: 我们沿着岸边搜寻失踪小船的任何痕迹。

examples.en: The offer was generous, but it came without any guarantee.
examples.cn: 这份提议很慷慨，却没有附带任何保证。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安妮」——有人问要哪一个，摊开手说「哪个都行」：任何一个

root: 古英语 ǣnig 由数词 ān「一」加形容词后缀 -ig 构成，本义是「像一那样的、单个的」。它在古英语里就已用于疑问与否定，义项由「一」扩展为「一些」；中古英语拼写固定为 any，并可用于复数名词；近代又发展出副词用法「在任何程度上」；现代英语中 anybody、anyone、anything、anywhere 等复合词完全定型。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses fan out from one gesture: pointing at a single unnamed member, then loosening it to 'some' in questions, shrinking it to 'even a little' under denial, opening it in a condition, and finally letting it stand alone as a pronoun.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个用法从同一个动作展开：先指向一个不点名的单个成员，再在疑问中松成「一些」，在否定中缩成「连一点」，在条件句中敞开，最后单独作代词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole group is laid open and one member is tapped, with no name given.
core.cn: 核心意象：把一整群摊开，随手点中一个成员，却不给出名字。

branches.en: THE SINGLE MEMBER LINE: one item picked from a class, left unnamed.
branches.cn: 单个成员线：从一类中取出一个，不点明是谁。

branches.en: THE QUESTION LINE: the unknown amount loosens into 'some, if there is any'.
branches.cn: 疑问线：未知的数量松成「如果有的话，那么一些」。

branches.en: THE DENIAL LINE: the unit shrinks until not even one grain remains.
branches.cn: 否定线：单位不断缩小，直到连一粒也不剩。

branches.en: THE CONDITION LINE: whichever member appears, the result is the same.
branches.cn: 条件线：无论哪个成员出现，结果都一样。

branches.en: THE PRONOUN LINE: the open choice stands alone, with no noun to hold it.
branches.cn: 代词线：敞开的选择独立站着，没有名词来支撑它。

intro.en: Any is a native construction of the numeral 'one' plus a suffix; the modern family is made by joining it to question words.
intro.cn: any 是由数词「一」加后缀构成的本族形式；现代这一族词则是把它接在疑问词上组成的。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin source. Any Latin-looking forms in the table are semantic parallels only and are not part of its history.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语来源。表中看似拉丁语的形式只是语义上的平行词，并不在它的历史之中。

items.example: The whole word began as a way of saying 'one-like'.
items.exampleCN: 整个词最初表达的是「像一那样的」。

items.example: Anything in the box may be borrowed.
items.exampleCN: 箱子里的任何东西都可以借走。

items.example: Anyone can join the evening class.
items.exampleCN: 任何人都可以参加晚间课程。

items.example: Anybody with a ticket may enter.
items.exampleCN: 任何持票的人都可以入场。

items.meaningCN: 在任何地方；到任何地方
items.example: We could not find the key anywhere.
items.exampleCN: 我们哪里都找不到那把钥匙。

items.meaning: in any way; in spite of that
items.example: Anyhow, the last train leaves at six.
items.exampleCN: 不管怎样，末班火车六点开。

items.example: Anyway, we should still try.
items.exampleCN: 无论如何，我们还是应该试一试。

items.meaningCN: 以任何方式，现为古旧用法
items.example: He could not help us anywise.
items.exampleCN: 他怎么也帮不上我们。

items.meaning: forming adjectives from nouns and numerals
items.meaningCN: 由名词或数词构成形容词的后缀
items.example: It turned ān into ǣnig.
items.exampleCN: 它把表示「一」的词变成了「任何一个」。

items.example: The numeral supplies the first half of the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个数词提供了整词的前一半。

definition_zh: 任何人；随便谁；无论谁；（非正式）要人、重要人物
definition_en: any person at all, used especially in questions and negatives; informally, also an important person
core_image: 把一整群人摊在眼前，随手点一个，不问是谁
scene: 雨夜的公交站，一个女人收起伞，对着排队的人问了一句。Is there anybody here who knows the way to the old harbor?
sceneCN: 这里 anybody 是「任何人」（第 1 个义项：在疑问句中指某个人，不限定是谁）；句意为「这里有谁知道去老港的路吗」。画面里有雨夜的站台、收起的伞和排队等车的人。

pos.zh: 代词：任何人；随便谁；无论谁
名词（非正式）：要人；重要人物

collocations.zh: 随便哪个人；任何一个人

derivatives.zh: 由本词加所有格符号构成，义为「任何人的」
与本词同义的复合代词，由 any 与 one 构成，语气略正式
肯定句中的对应词，由 some 与 body 构成，义为「某人」

senses.title: Any person, in a question
senses.definition: used in questions to ask whether some person, no matter who, is present or involved
senses.definitionCN: 用于疑问句，询问是否有某个人在场或参与，而不限定是谁
senses.example: Is there anybody here who knows the way to the old harbor?
senses.exampleCN: 这里有谁知道去老港的路吗？
senses.why: The compound joins 'any' to 'body' in its old sense of 'person', so the question sweeps over every person without naming one.
senses.whyCN: 这个复合词把 any 接在 body 的旧义「人」上，于是疑问扫过每一个人，却一个也不点名。

senses.title: Any person, in a negative
senses.definition: used after a negative word to mean no person at all
senses.definitionCN: 用在否定词之后，表示没有任何人
senses.example: There was hardly anybody left on the platform.
senses.exampleCN: 站台上几乎没有人剩下。
senses.why: Under denial the open sweep closes completely: every person is excluded, not merely unidentified.
senses.whyCN: 在否定之下，敞开的扫掠彻底合拢：每个人都被排除，而不只是未被指认。

senses.title: Any person at all, in a statement
senses.definition: used in affirmative statements to stress that no special qualification is needed
senses.definitionCN: 用于肯定陈述，强调不需要任何特殊资格
senses.example: Anybody with a ticket may enter the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 任何持票的人都可以进入大厅。
senses.why: The same wide sweep now grants access rather than asks a question: everyone in the class qualifies.
senses.whyCN: 同样的宽扫现在是在放行而不是发问：这一类里的每个人都符合条件。

senses.title: Some person, it does not matter who
senses.definition: used to mean some person chosen freely, with the choice treated as unimportant
senses.definitionCN: 表示随便某个人，选择本身被视为无关紧要
senses.example: Ask anybody on the street; they all know the bakery.
senses.exampleCN: 街上随便问一个人，他们都知道那家面包店。
senses.why: Here the word stops being a quantifier and becomes a shrug: whoever you happen to meet will do.
senses.whyCN: 这里的词不再是数量词，而是一个耸肩的动作：你碰巧遇到谁都行。

senses.title: An important person
senses.definition: informally, a person of importance or high social standing
senses.definitionCN: 非正式用法，指有地位或身份显要的人
senses.example: He acts like anybody now that the promotion has come through.
senses.exampleCN: 升职批下来之后，他摆出一副大人物的样子。
senses.why: The ironic twist is American: if 'anybody' can be anyone, then being 'anybody' must mean counting for something.
senses.whyCN: 这个反讽的转折来自美式用法：既然 anybody 可以是任何人，那么「成为 somebody」自然就意味着算个人物。

intro.en: Anybody is a native compound of two Old English words, and its second half once meant simply 'a body, a person'.
intro.cn: anybody 是由两个古英语词构成的本族复合词，它的后半部分当年只表示「身体、人」。

items.en: Bodig meant 'body, trunk', and by extension a living person; ān with -ig gave ǣnig 'any one'.
items.cn: bodig 表示「身体、躯干」，并引申指活人；ān 加 -ig 则构成 ǣnig「任何一个」。

items.en: The two words begin to appear side by side as any body, still with the literal sense of any physical body.
items.cn: 两个词开始并排出现，写作 any body，仍带着「任何一个身体」的字面义。

items.en: Body in this combination loses its physical weight and comes to mean 'person', so any body becomes a pronoun.
items.cn: 在这个组合里，body 失去身体的分量，转而指「人」，于是 any body 变成一个代词。

items.en: The spelling closes into anybody, and the word settles in questions and negatives beside anyone.
items.cn: 拼写合拢为 anybody，这个词与 anyone 并列，稳定出现在疑问句和否定句中。

items.en: A playful nominal use appears: to be anybody means to be a person of consequence.
items.cn: 一种戏谑的名词用法出现：to be anybody 意为成为有分量的人物。

items.en: The pronoun is standard in speech and writing; the 'important person' sense stays informal and often ironic.
items.cn: 代词用法在口语与书面语中都已标准；「重要人物」这一义项仍属非正式，常带反讽。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the any-compounds; the near-meaning group gathers the person words that answer it in different sentence types.
note.cn: 形近组收 any 构成的复合词；近义组收各种指人的词，它们分布在不同句式中。

entries.definition: A pronoun meaning any person, the closest twin of anybody.

entries.definition: A pronoun meaning any thing, used in the same sentence types.

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in or to any place.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「在任何地方、到任何地方」。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in any way or in spite of that.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「以任何方式」或「无论如何」。

entries.definition: An unspecified person, used mainly in affirmative sentences.
entries.definitionCN: 指某个未指明的人，主要用于肯定句，与疑问、否定中的 anybody 分工。

entries.definition: An unspecified person, slightly more formal than somebody.
entries.definitionCN: 指某个未指明的人，比 somebody 略正式。

entries.definition: No person at all, the negative partner of anybody.
entries.definitionCN: 指没有任何人，是 anybody 的否定对应词。

entries.definition: Every person in a group, taken as a whole rather than swept open.
entries.definitionCN: 指一组中的每个人，作为整体看待，而不是敞开扫过。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real 'body means person' history and the sentence types the pronoun actually lives in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用「body 曾指人」的真实历史和这个代词实际栖身的句式。

normal.en: Any plus body: body is the old word for a person, so the compound means 'any person'.
normal.cn: any 加 body：body 是「人」的旧说法，所以复合词就是「任何人」。

normal.en: Questions and negatives are its home: is anybody there? There isn't anybody.
normal.cn: 疑问与否定是它的家：有人吗？一个人也没有。

normal.en: In statements it grants entry: anybody with a ticket may come in.
normal.cn: 在肯定句里它负责放行：任何持票的人都能进。

normal.en: Somebody is its affirmative twin; nobody is its negative shadow.
normal.cn: somebody 是它在肯定句里的孪生兄弟，nobody 是否定里的影子。

normal.en: The informal noun is ironic: to be anybody is to count for something.
normal.cn: 非正式的名词用法带反讽：to be anybody 就是成为有分量的人物。

abstract.en: Picture a spotlight sweeping a crowd and landing on no face in particular.
abstract.cn: 想象一束聚光灯扫过人群，却没有落在任何一张特定的脸上。

abstract.en: The word is a net cast wide: it catches a person, any person, and never asks the name.
abstract.cn: 这个词是一张撒得很宽的网：它网住一个人、任何一个人，从不问名字。

abstract.en: Under a negative the net closes: nobody remains inside.
abstract.cn: 在否定之下网口合拢：里面再也留不下任何人。

examples.en: Is there anybody here who knows the way to the old harbor?
examples.cn: 这里有谁知道去老港的路吗？

examples.en: Anybody with a ticket may enter the hall before seven.
examples.cn: 任何持票的人都可以在七点前进入大厅。

examples.en: The room fell silent, and anybody could tell that the news was bad.
examples.cn: 房间静了下来，谁都看得出那消息不妙。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安妮body」——安妮把整个身体站出来问「还有谁」：任何人

root: anybody 是古英语两个词的本族复合：ǣnig「任何一个」加 bodig「身体、人」。十三世纪起写作 any body，仍带字面义；十六世纪 body 在此组合中转为「人」，整个形式成为代词；十八世纪拼写合拢为 anybody，与 anyone 并列用于疑问与否定；十九世纪美式口语又衍生出「要人、重要人物」的名词义。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses fan out from one sweep over a crowd: a question about who is present, a denial that anyone is left, a general permission, a shrug of free choice, and an ironic name for a person of weight.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个用法从对人海的一次扫掠展开：询问谁在场、否认还剩谁、普遍放行、随意选择的一耸肩，以及反讽地称呼有分量的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wide sweep over a crowd, catching a person without asking for a name.
core.cn: 核心意象：对人群做一次宽扫，网住一个人却不问名字。

branches.en: THE QUESTION LINE: is there a person of this kind here at all?
branches.cn: 疑问线：这里到底有没有这一类的人？

branches.en: THE DENIAL LINE: the net closes and no person remains.
branches.cn: 否定线：网口合拢，一个人也不剩。

branches.en: THE PERMISSION LINE: everyone in the class is allowed in.
branches.cn: 放行线：这一类里的每个人都被允许进入。

branches.en: THE SHRUG LINE: whoever you meet will do just as well.
branches.cn: 耸肩线：你遇到谁，谁就一样合适。

branches.en: THE IRONY LINE: being anybody turns into counting for something.
branches.cn: 反讽线：成为 anybody 反而变成算个人物。

intro.en: The word is a compound, so its structure is easy to see: any plus a word for a person, with parallel forms for thing, one and where.
intro.cn: 这个词是复合词，结构一眼可见：any 加上一个指人的词，并有 thing、one、where 等平行形式。

latinIntro.en: Anybody has no Latin source; its parts are Old English. Latin person words such as corpus are parallels in meaning only.
latinIntro.cn: anybody 没有拉丁语来源，它的组成部分都是古英语。像 corpus 这样的拉丁语指人词只是语义上的平行。

items.example: Anybody can see that the door is open.
items.exampleCN: 谁都看得出那扇门是开着的。

items.example: Somebody left a coat on the chair.
items.exampleCN: 有人把外套落在椅子上了。

items.example: Nobody came to the early meeting.
items.exampleCN: 没有人来参加早会。

items.example: Everybody stood up when the music began.
items.exampleCN: 音乐开始时每个人都站了起来。

items.meaningCN: 用于不定代词中表示「人」的构词成分
items.example: It gives the pronouns their human sense.
items.exampleCN: 它赋予这些代词以人的含义。

items.meaning: the physical frame; formerly also a person
items.example: The older sense survives inside the pronoun.
items.exampleCN: 较古的义项仍活在这个代词内部。

items.meaningCN: 任何人，是并列的同义形式
items.example: Anyone may borrow the red umbrella.
items.exampleCN: 任何人都可以借那把红伞。

items.example: Anything on the lower shelf is free.
items.exampleCN: 下层架子上的任何东西都免费。

definition_zh: 无论如何；不管怎样；随便地；草率地；杂乱地
definition_en: in any way; also in spite of that, or in a careless and untidy manner
core_image: 路怎么走都行，反正要到那个地方去
scene: 山间岔路口，两个旅人看了看被雨冲坏的路牌。Anyhow, we can still reach the village before dark.
sceneCN: 这里 anyhow 是「无论如何」（第 1 个义项：不管用什么方式、有什么阻碍，结论照旧成立）；句意为「无论如何，我们还是能在天黑前赶到村里」。画面里有山间岔路口、被雨冲坏的路牌和两个停下来商量的旅人。

pos.zh: 副词：无论如何；不管怎样；随便地；草率地

collocations.zh: 横七竖八地；勉强凑合地

derivatives.zh: 由 anyway 类推加 -s 形成的口语变体，义为「反正、无论如何」
由 any 加后缀 -wise 构成，义为「以任何方式」，现为古旧用法
由 any 与 way 构成的同族复合词，义为「无论如何、反正」

senses.title: In spite of everything
senses.definition: used to say that something remains true or will still happen despite what has just been said
senses.definitionCN: 用于表示尽管刚说过某种情况，某事仍然成立或仍会发生
senses.example: We missed the last bus, but anyhow we walked home.
senses.exampleCN: 我们错过了末班车，不过反正还是走回了家。
senses.why: The word began as 'any way at all'; once every route is allowed, obstacles stop being decisive, and the conclusion holds regardless.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初是「随便哪种方式都行」；当每条路都被允许，阻碍就不再起决定作用，结论也就照旧成立。

senses.title: In any manner whatsoever
senses.definition: in any way or by any method, with the method left entirely open
senses.definitionCN: 以任何方式或任何方法，方法本身完全敞开
senses.example: Try to open the jar anyhow you can; the lid is stuck.
senses.exampleCN: 盖子是卡住的，你想用什么办法打开这个罐子都行。
senses.why: Here the compound is still literal: any plus how, every possible method laid on the table at once.
senses.whyCN: 这里复合词仍取字面义：any 加 how，所有可能的办法一次性摊在桌上。

senses.title: Carelessly, without method
senses.definition: done without care, order, or proper method
senses.definitionCN: 做事不讲心思、顺序或正当方法
senses.example: He does his work anyhow and never checks the figures.
senses.exampleCN: 他做事随随便便，从不核对数字。
senses.why: If any way will do, then no way is chosen carefully; the open choice curdles into carelessness.
senses.whyCN: 如果哪种方式都行，那就没有一种被认真挑选；敞开的选择由此凝结成草率。

senses.title: Untidily, in disorder
senses.definition: placed or arranged without order, so that things lie in a jumble
senses.definitionCN: 摆放或安排没有次序，东西堆成一团乱
senses.example: The shelves were stacked anyhow, with cans behind boxes.
senses.exampleCN: 架子上的东西堆得横七竖八，罐头都塞在箱子后面。
senses.why: The physical picture grows out of the careless sense: when placement follows no plan, the result looks like a heap.
senses.whyCN: 这个具体的画面从「草率」一义长出来：摆放不依任何计划，结果就成了一堆。

senses.title: Anyway, to close a topic
senses.definition: used in speech to end a topic or return to the main point, much like anyway
senses.definitionCN: 口语中用于结束一个话题或回到正题，作用近似 anyway
senses.example: Anyhow, that is the story; now let us get back to work.
senses.exampleCN: 总之，故事就是这样；现在我们回去干活吧。
senses.why: A word that dismisses obstacles is ready-made for dismissing side topics, so it becomes a conversational hinge.
senses.whyCN: 一个能打发障碍的词，天生也适合打发枝节话题，于是它成了会话里的转轴。

intro.en: Anyhow is a native compound of any and how, built in English rather than borrowed from another language.
intro.cn: anyhow 是 any 与 how 构成的本族复合词，是在英语内部造出来的，并非从别的语言借入。

items.en: The interrogative hū 'how' is old and common, and ǣnig 'any' already existed beside it.
items.cn: 疑问词 hū「如何」古老而常用，ǣnig「任何一个」当时也已与它并存。

items.en: The two words are joined as any how, first meaning 'in any manner', literally any possible way of doing something.
items.cn: 两个词合成 any how，最初表示「以任何方式」，字面就是做某事的任何一种可能办法。

items.en: The spelling closes into anyhow, and the word begins to carry the concessive sense 'in spite of that'.
items.cn: 拼写合拢为 anyhow，这个词开始带上让步义「尽管如此」。

items.en: The careless sense 'in a slovenly way' becomes common in descriptions of work and arrangement.
items.cn: 「草率、马虎」这一义项在描写干活与摆放的文字里变得常见。

items.en: In speech anyhow also serves as a topic closer, a role it shares with anyway; the literal 'any way' sense survives chiefly in set phrases.
items.cn: 口语中 anyhow 还充当收束话题的词，这一角色与 anyway 共有；字面的「任何方式」义主要活在固定短语里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the close compounds and variants; the near-meaning group gathers the connectives and adverbs that express the same concession.
note.cn: 形近组收与它最接近的复合词和变体；近义组收表达同样让步关系的连接词与副词。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in spite of that, the closest twin of anyhow.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「无论如何、反正」，是 anyhow 最接近的对应词。

entries.definition: A colloquial variant of anyway, common in informal speech.
entries.definitionCN: anyway 的口语变体，常见于非正式谈话。

entries.definition: An archaic adverb meaning in any manner.
entries.definitionCN: 古旧副词，义为「以任何方式」。

entries.definition: A connective meaning despite that, used to contrast two statements.
entries.definitionCN: 连接词，义为「然而、尽管如此」，用于对比前后两句，语气比 anyhow 正式。

entries.definition: A formal connective meaning in spite of that.
entries.definitionCN: 正式连接词，义为「尽管如此」，书面语气最强。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning without being affected by the circumstances.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「不加理会、无论如何」，强调不受情况影响。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in a random, unplanned way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「随意地、杂乱地」，与 anyhow 的草率义最接近。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real any-plus-how structure and the different sentence positions the word occupies.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的 any 加 how 结构，以及这个词占据的不同句子位置。

normal.en: Split it: any plus how. Every possible method is left on the table.
normal.cn: 拆开看：any 加 how，每一种可能的办法都被摊在桌上。

normal.en: At the start of a sentence it concedes: anyhow, we can still get there.
normal.cn: 放在句首时它在让步：无论如何，我们还是能到那儿。

normal.en: Its twin is anyway; both began as 'any way at all'.
normal.cn: 它的孪生兄弟是 anyway，两者都由「随便哪条路都行」开始。

normal.en: If any way will do, no way is chosen: that is how it comes to mean carelessly.
normal.cn: 如果哪条路都行，就没有哪条被选中，这就是它转而表示草率的原因。

normal.en: Use it to close a topic, the way a hand waves a side issue away.
normal.cn: 用它收束话题，就像用手把枝节问题一挥而去。

abstract.en: Picture a road sign with every arrow pointing, and a walker who shrugs and takes any of them.
abstract.cn: 想象一块路牌上所有箭头都指着方向，而走路的人耸耸肩，随便挑了其中一个。

abstract.en: The word is a shrug turned into sound: obstacles are admitted, then brushed aside.
abstract.cn: 这个词是一声耸肩变成了声音：承认阻碍存在，然后把它拂开。

abstract.en: Carelessness is the shadow side: a choice so open that no choice is made.
abstract.cn: 草率是它的暗面：选择太敞开，以至于等于没有选择。

examples.en: We missed the last bus, but anyhow we walked home.
examples.cn: 我们错过了末班车，不过反正还是走回了家。

examples.en: The shelves were stacked anyhow, with cans behind boxes.
examples.cn: 架子上的东西堆得横七竖八，罐头都塞在箱子后面。

examples.en: Anyhow, that is the story; now let us get back to work.
examples.cn: 总之，故事就是这样；现在我们回去干活吧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安妮好」——路都被雨冲坏了，旅人还是说「安妮好，能到」：无论如何

root: anyhow 由 any「任何一个」与 how「如何」在本族英语中复合而成。十六世纪写作 any how，义为「以任何方式」；十七世纪拼写合拢，并发展出让步义「尽管如此」；十九世纪又生出「草率、杂乱」的具体义；现代口语里还兼任收束话题的转轴，作用与 anyway 相近。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses fan out from 'any way at all': the concessive 'in spite of that', the literal open method, the careless manner, the untidy result, and the conversational topic closer.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个用法从「随便哪条路都行」展开：让步的「尽管如此」、字面的开放方法、草率的方式、杂乱的结果，以及会话中收束话题的用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: every route is allowed, so no obstacle can decide the outcome.
core.cn: 核心意象：每条路都被允许，于是任何阻碍都无法决定结果。

branches.en: THE CONCESSION LINE: obstacles are admitted, yet the conclusion stands.
branches.cn: 让步线：承认阻碍存在，结论却照旧立住。

branches.en: THE METHOD LINE: every possible way of doing it is left open.
branches.cn: 方法线：每一种可行的做法都敞开着。

branches.en: THE CARELESS LINE: when any way will do, none is chosen with care.
branches.cn: 草率线：既然哪条路都行，就没有一条被认真挑选。

branches.en: THE DISORDER LINE: placement without a plan turns into a heap.
branches.cn: 杂乱线：不依计划的摆放堆成一团。

branches.en: THE HINGE LINE: the same shrug waves a side topic away.
branches.cn: 转轴线：同一次耸肩把枝节话题也挥走了。

intro.en: Anyhow is transparently built: any plus how, with parallel compounds on way, wise and thing.
intro.cn: anyhow 的构造一目了然：any 加 how，并有 way、wise、thing 等平行复合形式。

definition_zh: 任何人；随便哪个人；无论谁
definition_en: any person at all, used chiefly in questions and negatives, and also in affirmative statements for emphasis
core_image: 把整个人群摊开，随意取一个，不点名字
scene: 清晨的候车室里，值班员抬眼看了看空荡的座位，对着门口喊了一声。Can anyone help me move these chairs?
sceneCN: 这里 anyone 是「任何人」（第 1 个义项：在疑问句中询问有没有某个人，不限定是谁）；句意为「有谁能帮我搬一下这些椅子吗」。画面里有清晨的候车室、空荡的座位和站在门口的值班员。

pos.zh: 代词：任何人；随便哪个人；无论谁

collocations.zh: 随便哪个人；任何一个人

derivatives.zh: 由本词加所有格符号构成，义为「任何人的」

senses.title: Any person, in a question
senses.definition: used in questions to ask whether some person, whoever it may be, is available or involved
senses.definitionCN: 用于疑问句，询问是否有某个人可以帮忙或参与，而不限定是谁
senses.example: Can anyone help me move these chairs?
senses.exampleCN: 有谁能帮我搬一下这些椅子吗？
senses.why: One means a single person and any opens the choice, so the question ranges over the whole crowd without settling on a name.
senses.whyCN: one 指单个的人，any 又把选择敞开，于是这个问句扫过整个人群，却不在任何名字上落定。

senses.title: No person, after a negative
senses.definition: used after a negative to mean that no person at all is present or affected
senses.definitionCN: 用在否定词之后，表示没有任何人在场或受到影响
senses.example: I did not meet anyone on the stairs.
senses.exampleCN: 我在楼梯上没有遇到任何人。
senses.why: The negative closes the open range completely, so the pronoun ends up excluding every possible person.
senses.whyCN: 否定把敞开的范围彻底合上，于是这个代词最终把每一个可能的人都排除在外。

senses.title: Any person at all, for emphasis
senses.definition: used in affirmative statements to stress that no special condition or exception applies
senses.definitionCN: 用于肯定陈述，强调不存在任何特殊条件或例外
senses.example: The rule applies to anyone living in the building.
senses.exampleCN: 这条规定适用于住在这栋楼里的任何人。
senses.why: In a statement the same wide range turns into a guarantee of universality rather than a question.
senses.whyCN: 在陈述句中，同样宽的范围不再发问，而变成一种普遍适用的保证。

senses.title: Some person, it does not matter who
senses.definition: used to mean some person picked freely, with the identity treated as irrelevant
senses.definitionCN: 表示随便某个人，身份被视为无关紧要
senses.example: Anyone in the front row could answer that question.
senses.exampleCN: 前排随便哪个人都能回答那个问题。
senses.why: The choice is deliberately left blank; the point is that no particular person needs to be singled out.
senses.whyCN: 选择被故意留白；重点在于不需要特别点出某一个人。

intro.en: Anyone is a native compound of any and one, and the numeral inside it is the same old word that gave the indefinite sense.
intro.cn: anyone 是 any 与 one 构成的本族复合词，其中的数词正是赋予它不定意义的那个古老词。

items.en: Ān was the ordinary numeral 'one', and ǣnig 'any' was already built from it with a suffix.
items.cn: ān 是普通的数词「一」，而 ǣnig「任何一个」早已由它加后缀构成。

items.en: Any and one are used together in writing, at first as two separate words meaning 'any single person'.
items.cn: any 与 one 开始并排出现在文字里，最初是两个分开的词，表示「任何一个单个的人」。

items.en: The combination closes into anyone and takes over the pronoun role in questions and negatives.
items.cn: 这一组合合拢为 anyone，接管疑问句和否定句中指人的代词角色。

items.en: Anyone and anybody settle into a stable pair, with anyone slightly more formal in writing.
items.cn: anyone 与 anybody 稳定成一对，其中 anyone 在书面语中略正式。

items.en: The pronoun is fully standard; the possessive anyone's is written with an apostrophe, and the word never takes a plural.
items.cn: 这个代词已完全标准；所有格 anyone's 带撇号书写，且这个词从不用复数。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the any-compounds; the near-meaning group gathers the person pronouns that divide the same ground by sentence type.
note.cn: 形近组收 any 构成的复合词；近义组收指人的代词，它们按句式分摊同一片地盘。

entries.definition: A pronoun meaning any person, the informal twin of anyone.

entries.definitionCN: 代词，义为「任何事物」，出现在相同的句式中。

entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「在任何地方、到任何地方」。

entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「以任何方式」或「无论如何」。

entries.definition: An unspecified person, used mainly in affirmative sentences.
entries.definitionCN: 指某个未指明的人，主要用于肯定句，与 anyone 分工。

entries.definition: Every person in a group, considered as a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 指一组中的每个人，作为整体考虑，范围是全部而不是任意一个。

entries.definition: No person at all, the negative counterpart of anyone.
entries.definitionCN: 指没有任何人，是 anyone 在否定意义上的对应词。

entries.definitionCN: 义为「无论谁」，用于引导从句，选择范围比 anyone 更明确。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real any-plus-one structure and the sentence types where the pronoun is at home.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的 any 加 one 结构，以及这个代词最自在的句式。

normal.en: Any plus one: literally 'any single one', so the pronoun means any person.
normal.cn: any 加 one：字面就是「任何一个单个的」，所以这个代词指任何人。

normal.en: Questions and negatives are home ground: can anyone help? I saw no one.
normal.cn: 疑问与否定是它的主场：有谁能帮忙？我一个人也没看见。

normal.en: In statements it makes a rule universal: anyone living here must obey it.
normal.cn: 在陈述句里它让规则变得普遍：住在这里的任何人都不例外。

normal.en: Anyone and anybody are twins; anyone is the slightly more formal one.
normal.cn: anyone 与 anybody 是一对孪生，anyone 略正式一些。

normal.en: The possessive is anyone's, with the apostrophe before the s.
normal.cn: 所有格是 anyone's，撇号放在 s 之前。

abstract.en: Picture a hand reaching into a crowd and pulling out one person, face still unseen.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸进人群，拉出一个人来，脸仍然看不清。

abstract.en: The word is an open circle: every person stands at the edge, none at the centre.
abstract.cn: 这个词是一个敞开的圆：每个人都站在边上，没有一个在中心。

abstract.en: Under denial the circle empties, and no face is left inside.
abstract.cn: 在否定之下圆圈被清空，里面一张脸也不剩。

examples.en: Can anyone help me move these chairs?
examples.cn: 有谁能帮我搬一下这些椅子吗？

examples.en: Anyone who saw the accident should speak to the police.
examples.cn: 任何看到那起事故的人都应该向警方说明情况。

examples.en: The rule applies to anyone living in the building.
examples.cn: 这条规定适用于住在这栋楼里的任何人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安妮万」——值班员问「安妮万，有谁能搭把手」，安妮万举手：任何人

root: anyone 由 any「任何一个」与 one「一」在本族英语中复合而成。中古英语时两者并排使用，表示「任何一个单个的人」；十六世纪合拢为 anyone，接管疑问与否定中指人的代词角色；十八世纪与 anybody 稳定成对，anyone 在书面语中略正式；现代所有格写作 anyone's，且没有复数形式。

sensesIntro.en: Four uses fan out from 'any single one': a question about who is available, a denial that a person is there, a universal rule, and a deliberately blank free pick.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个用法从「任何一个单个的」展开：询问谁可以帮忙、否认有人在场、普遍适用的规则，以及故意留白的随意挑选。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open circle of people, one of them pulled out while the face stays unseen.
core.cn: 核心意象：围成一圈的人群敞开着，其中一人被拉出来，脸却始终看不清。

branches.en: THE QUESTION LINE: is there any single person who can do this?
branches.cn: 疑问线：到底有没有哪一个单个的人能做成这件事？

branches.en: THE DENIAL LINE: the circle closes and no single person remains.
branches.cn: 否定线：圆圈合拢，连一个单个的人也不剩。

branches.en: THE UNIVERSAL LINE: the rule covers every single person inside.
branches.cn: 普遍线：规则覆盖圈内的每一个单个的人。

branches.en: THE BLANK PICK LINE: identity is irrelevant, any face will do.
branches.cn: 留白线：身份无关紧要，随便哪张脸都行。

branches.en: THE TWIN LINE: anyone and anybody divide the same ground by tone.
branches.cn: 孪生线：anyone 与 anybody 按语气分摊同一片地盘。

intro.en: Anyone is a clean compound of any and one, sitting in a family of pronouns built the same way.
intro.cn: anyone 是 any 与 one 的干净复合，处在一族用同样办法造出的代词之中。

latinIntro.en: Anyone has no Latin source; the Latin indefinite pronouns such as aliquis are functional parallels only.
latinIntro.cn: anyone 没有拉丁语来源；像 aliquis 这样的拉丁语不定代词只是在功能上平行。

items.example: Anyone may use the reading room.

items.example: Anybody can learn to swim.
items.exampleCN: 任何人都能学会游泳。

items.example: Anything on this list may be ordered.

items.exampleCN: 我哪里都找不到那张票。

items.exampleCN: 房间里的每个人都听见了铃声。

items.example: Someone has moved the blue chair.
items.exampleCN: 有人挪动了那把蓝椅子。

items.meaning: the numeral one; also an indefinite person
items.meaningCN: 数词「一」；也可泛指某个人
items.example: One should always check the lock.
items.exampleCN: 人总该检查一下门锁。

items.meaningCN: 在不定代词中表示「人」的构词成分
items.example: It supplies the human sense of the pronoun.
items.exampleCN: 它为这些代词提供指人的含义。

definition_zh: 任何事物；任何东西；无论什么
definition_en: any thing at all, used chiefly in questions and negatives, and in affirmative statements for emphasis
core_image: 把一整箱东西倒在地上，随手捡起一件，不问是哪一件
scene: 阁楼的木箱被拖到窗前，灰尘在光柱里浮动。Anything in this trunk may be useful to the museum.
sceneCN: 这里 anything 是「任何事物」（第 1 个义项：指某件东西，不限定是哪一件）；句意为「这个箱子里任何东西都可能对博物馆有用」。画面里有阁楼的木箱、窗前的光柱和浮动的灰尘。

pos.zh: 代词：任何事物；任何东西；无论什么

collocations.zh: 别的什么东西；还有其他东西
如果说有什么区别的话
随便什么东西；任何东西

derivatives.zh: 与 anything 并列的复合词，由 some 与 thing 构成，主要用于肯定句
与 anything 并列的复合词，由 every 与 thing 构成，义为「一切事物」
与 anything 并列的复合词，由 no 与 thing 构成，义为「没有什么」

senses.title: Any thing, in a question
senses.definition: used in questions to ask whether some thing, whatever it may be, exists or is wanted
senses.definitionCN: 用于疑问句，询问是否有某件东西存在或需要，而不限定是哪一件
senses.example: Do you need anything from the market?
senses.exampleCN: 你需要从市场上带点什么吗？
senses.why: Any opens the range and thing names the field, so the question covers every object without naming a single one.
senses.whyCN: any 把范围敞开，thing 划定领域，于是这个问句覆盖每一件东西，却一件也不点名。

senses.title: No thing, after a negative
senses.definition: used after a negative to mean that no thing at all is involved or present
senses.definitionCN: 用在否定词之后，表示完全不涉及或不存在任何东西
senses.example: She did not say anything about the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 关于那次延误，她什么也没说。
senses.why: The negative shuts the open range, so the wide 'any thing' becomes 'not a single thing'.
senses.whyCN: 否定把敞开的范围关上，于是宽泛的「任何东西」变成「连一件也没有」。

senses.title: Any thing at all, for emphasis
senses.titleCN: 任何事物（用于肯定强调）
senses.definition: used in affirmative statements to stress that no restriction or exception applies
senses.definitionCN: 用于肯定陈述，强调不存在任何限制或例外
senses.example: Anything you find in the drawer is yours to keep.
senses.exampleCN: 你在抽屉里找到的任何东西都归你。
senses.why: In a statement the same open range turns into a blanket promise rather than a doubt.
senses.whyCN: 在陈述句中，同样敞开的范围不再表示疑问，而变成一句笼统的允诺。

senses.title: Whatever thing, in a condition
senses.titleCN: 无论什么东西（用于条件与让步）
senses.definition: used in clauses with if or whether to mean that no particular thing matters
senses.definitionCN: 用于由 if 或 whether 引导的从句，表示无论什么东西都无所谓
senses.example: If anything goes wrong, call the number on the box.
senses.exampleCN: 如果出了任何问题，就打盒子上的那个号码。
senses.why: The conditional frame leaves the object completely unspecified, since the response must fit whatever turns up.
senses.whyCN: 条件句的框架让对象完全不被指定，因为应对方式必须能适配任何冒出来的东西。

senses.title: In the phrase anything but
senses.titleCN: 决不；根本不（用于 anything but）
senses.definition: in the phrase anything but, used to mean definitely not or the opposite of
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 anything but，表示决不、根本不是或恰恰相反
senses.example: The journey was anything but relaxing.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅程根本谈不上轻松。
senses.why: The phrase works by contrast: every thing is allowed except the one named, so that one is emphatically excluded.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语靠对比运作：除了被点名的那一个，别的都允许，于是被点名者被强烈排除。

intro.en: Anything is a native compound of any and thing, and thing once meant a matter or an assembly rather than a physical object.
intro.cn: anything 是 any 与 thing 的本族复合，而 thing 当年指一件事或一次集会，而不是物理物件。

items.en: Þing meant 'assembly, matter, affair', and only later narrowed towards a concrete object; ǣnig 'any' was already common.
items.cn: þing 表示「集会、事情、事务」，后来才收窄指具体物件；ǣnig「任何一个」当时已很常见。

items.en: The two words appear side by side as any thing, meaning 'any matter or object', still written as two words.
items.cn: 两个词并排出现，写作 any thing，表示「任何事情或物件」，仍分作两个词书写。

items.en: The combination closes into anything and takes its place as the pronoun for questions and negatives.
items.cn: 这个组合合拢为 anything，成为疑问句与否定句中指物的代词。

items.en: The contrastive phrase anything but is recorded, using the open range to exclude one named thing absolutely.
items.cn: 对比短语 anything but 有记载，用敞开的范围把被点名的那个东西彻底排除。

items.en: The pronoun is standard everywhere; compounds on thing form a neat set with some, every and no.
items.cn: 这个代词在各处都已标准；以 thing 构成的复合词与 some、every、no 配成整齐的一套。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the any-compounds; the near-meaning group gathers the thing-pronouns that divide the same field by sentence type.
note.cn: 形近组收 any 构成的复合词；近义组收指物的代词，它们按句式分摊同一片领域。

entries.definition: A pronoun meaning any person, built on the same any.
entries.definitionCN: 代词，义为「任何人」，由同一个 any 构成。

entries.definition: A pronoun meaning any person, with an informal tone.
entries.definitionCN: 代词，义为「任何人」，语气更口语。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in or to any place.

entries.definition: An adverb meaning in any way or in spite of that.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「以任何方式」或「无论如何」。

entries.definition: An unspecified thing, used mainly in affirmative sentences.
entries.definitionCN: 指某件未指明的东西，主要用于肯定句，与疑问、否定中的 anything 分工。

entries.definition: All things, taken together as a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 指所有事物，作为整体看待，范围是全部而不是任意一件。

entries.definition: No thing at all, the negative partner of anything.
entries.definitionCN: 指没有任何东西，是 anything 的否定对应词。

entries.definition: Anything at all of a kind, with the widest possible range.
entries.definitionCN: 指某一类中的任何事物，范围最宽，语气也最强。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real any-plus-thing construction and the sentence types where the pronoun lives.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用真实的 any 加 thing 构造，以及这个代词栖身的句式。

normal.en: Any plus thing: any single object in the field, name not required.
normal.cn: any 加 thing：领域里的任意一件，不需要名字。

normal.en: Its home is the question and the denial: anything to eat? I did not see anything.
normal.cn: 它的家是疑问与否定：有吃的吗？我什么也没看见。

normal.en: In statements it becomes a promise: anything in the box is yours.
normal.cn: 在陈句里它变成允诺：箱子里的任何东西都归你。

normal.en: With but it flips to exclusion: anything but calm means not calm at all.
normal.cn: 与 but 连用就翻成排除：anything but calm 就是一点也不平静。

normal.en: The thing family is regular: some, every, no, any.
normal.cn: 以 thing 构成的这一族很规整：some、every、no、any。

abstract.en: Picture an open crate with every object equally available, none labelled.
abstract.cn: 想象一只敞开的箱子，每件东西都能拿，却没有一件贴标签。

abstract.en: The word is a blank cheque written over the whole world of objects.
abstract.cn: 这个词是一张对整个物件世界开出的空白支票。

abstract.en: With but, the cheque is torn up for one named thing only.
abstract.cn: 与 but 连用时，这张支票只针对被点名的那一件被撕掉。

root: anything 是 any「任何一个」与 thing 的本族复合。古英语 þing 本指「集会、事情」，后收窄指具体物件；中古英语写作 any thing，义为「任何事情或物件」；十六世纪合拢为 anything，成为疑问与否定中指物的代词；十七世纪出现对比短语 anything but；现代英语中与 something、everything、nothing 配成整齐的一套。

sensesIntro.en: Five uses fan out from one open field of objects: a question about what exists, a denial of everything, a blanket promise, a condition that fits whatever appears, and the sharp exclusion of anything but.
sensesIntro.cn: 五个用法从一片敞开的物件领域展开：询问存在什么、否认一切、笼统允诺、适配任何情况的条件句，以及 anything but 的锋利排除。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open crate of objects, every one available, none labelled.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只敞开的物件箱，每一件都能拿，却没有一件贴标签。

branches.en: THE QUESTION LINE: does some object of this field exist or get wanted?
branches.cn: 疑问线：这片领域里到底有没有某件东西存在或被需要？

branches.en: THE DENIAL LINE: the whole field is shut and not one object remains.
branches.cn: 否定线：整片领域被关上，一件东西也不剩。

branches.en: THE PROMISE LINE: everything inside the field is granted without exception.
branches.cn: 允诺线：领域之内的每一样都被无条件给出。

branches.en: THE CONDITION LINE: the object stays blank so any outcome can be met.
branches.cn: 条件线：对象保持空白，以便应对任何结果。

branches.en: THE EXCLUSION LINE: everything is allowed except the one named thing.
branches.cn: 排除线：除了被点名的那一件，别的都允许。

intro.en: Anything is a transparent compound of any and thing, standing in a regular set with some, every and no.
intro.cn: anything 是 any 与 thing 的透明复合，并与 some、every、no 组成规整的一套。

latinIntro.en: Anything has no Latin source. Latin res and quid are semantic parallels, not ancestors of the word.
latinIntro.cn: anything 没有拉丁语来源。拉丁语的 res 与 quid 只是语义上的平行，并不是这个词的祖先。

definition_zh: 无论如何；反正；不管怎样；另外；此外

sceneCN: 这里 anyway 是「无论如何」（第 1 个义项：尽管前面说了不利情况，结论仍然成立）；句意为「无论如何，音乐会一小时后开始，而我们反正已经淋湿了」。画面里有越下越大的雨、湿透的票根和站台上等待的人。

还是谢谢你；不管怎样都谢谢
